_doc: Hand-verified timer zone fixes for map builds whose SurfTimer preset doesn't fit (loaded by src/maps/zones.ts getZoneOverrides). Per map: 'zones' replace preset zones with the same type (t), group (g) and index (i) or are added; 'remove' drops preset zones by t/g/i. Boxes: a = mins, b = maxs (Source units). Every entry is checked again at load time (src/game/zoneresolve.ts zoneReachable) and covered by a real-map test (tests/gameworld_zone_overrides.test.ts). Original data, not derived from SurfTimer's ck_zones.

surf_utopia_njv.note: The surf_utopia_v3 preset (alias) puts the end 1790 units above this build's end ledge and a second start 251 units above the start floor. End = the end ledge: the only floor in the final hall (hull traces land at z -6224 over x -14336..-13824, |y| <= 1023; everything else drops to the z -8192 jail teleports), marked by the func_illusionary end pad #142 [-14336,-1023,-6224]-[-13823,1023,-6208], with the back-wall return teleport #141 (target 'start') in a recess at its far side. 256 units tall so a player sliding down the back wall enters it before touching #141 (top -6096).
